business.E: All three bind A to matching manufacturer evidence and keep wrong-variant/stale B UNKNOWN and ineligible; no high-commission ranking or cross-variant evidence reuse.
business.missing_metrics: Confirmed contribution profit remains null; missing safety, dimensions, performance, warranty and other evidence is not invented.
business.limitation: VERIFIED is synthetic-input identity matching, not external product verification or market superiority.
